text.p: Close of play scores on the third day of four-day English County Championship cricket matches on Friday:
At Cheltenham: Gloucestershire beat Derbyshire by an innings and 35 runs. Derbyshire 120 and 329. Gloucestershire 484. Gloucestershire 24 points, Derbyshire 4.
At Scarborough: Yorkshire beat Durham by an innings and 56 runs. Durham 152 and 164. Yorkshire 372. Yorkshire 24 points, Durham 4.
At Canterbury: Kent 498-9 declared and 26-0 declared. Leicestershire 160-4 declared and 20-0.
At Old Trafford: Lancashire 561-8 declared. Sussex 307 and 150-4.
At Trent Bridge: Warwickshire 344. Nottinghamshire 133 and 279-4.
